summary: RREEF Property Trust filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, declaring monthly distributions for all classes of common stock for September 2026. Gross distribution is $0.07495 per share; net amounts vary by class after dealer manager and distribution fees: Class A $0.06392, Class I $0.06924, Class D/M-I/N/Z $0.07495, Class T $0.06221, Class T2 $0.06549. Payable October 2 to holders of record October 1. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine REIT cash distribution, not a special situation.
